Entries.Original: What's up with these lumpy white bread rolls? They look like they're straight out of Heidi.
Oh, woah. They're really soft and fluffy!
Yeah, yeah!
While white bread is made from refined wheat flour, dark rye bread is made from barley.
Wheat doesn't grow in poor soil, so they'd only be able to make rye bread in those areas. That's why white bread is seen as such a luxury.
That's some suuuper useless trivia, Intel Agent.
Even this plain-old pasta is freaking delicious!
That's peperoncino spaghetti.
It's amazing! Someone call the chef, I need to praise them! Where's the waiter?
There isn't one. Even if there was, the only person who'd come out is the lunch lady.
(Phew, time to head back.)
(Hm? Are those the 30-G members?)
The new squad we fought today wasn't half bad.
Agreed. These days it's been nothing but bad news, so it's a nice change of pace.
However, they still have a long way to go before they'll prove useful on the battlefield.
The new squad members we fought today were flailing around like freshly hatched chicks.
Well, it is only their third day. When you consider that, their future looks bright.
You're quite generous with those little brats. They were quite rude.
We used to be just like them... That aside, what of tomorrow's operation?
We'll be clearing out the Cancers around Takasaki.
Yes, multiple Cancers have been spotted around the vicinity of the Takasaki Dome.
According to our recon teams, there are three Cancer swarms in the area.
The commander has asked us to thin out these swarms. Kura, determine our route. Kiryu, please assist her.
You got it, Shirakawa.
Gladly.
We'll be busy on the battlefield from tomorrow morning, so please use this time to regain your strength.
(No wonder she's their leader. Even her instructions sound dignified...)
